lines.en: label day281:
scene nodokaoffice1
I lean back in my office chair and wait for Nodoka to arrive.
Today is the day that she’s supposed to be briefing me on whatever her “mission” is and, suffice it to say, I’m a little on edge.
My whole approach to teaching has been just leaving everyone alone, so the thought that I might need to make special accommodations for someone new is...
Well, not a thing I want to do.
But if that’s the price that must be paid to get another cute (And apparently very smart) girl into the class...I guess I’ll see what I can do.
Or, I could completely luck out and her final condition could just be sleeping with her or something.
It wouldn’t be the first time something like that has been offered up during an initial office visit.
Thanks again, Kirin.
: Helloooo? Sensei?
: May I come in?
: Yes. And I accept.
scene nodokaoffice2
: Oh?
: And what are you accepting exactly?
: I spoke preemptively. I imagined a final condition in my head and I’m pretty sure I got it wrong.
: Please, do tell what it is that you imagined.
: I probably shouldn’t.
scene nodokaoffice3
: You don’t need to. The fact that you’re unwilling to tell me means that it’s likely something sexual in nature, to which I must refuse.
: Well then what do you want, exactly?
: Right down to brass tacks, then? No small talk?
: I figured it might be good to get to know each other a little better before informing you of my plan.
: Well, what sort of things do you want to know?
: If it’s my age, I’m delighted to inform you that I know it now.
: Congratulations, Sensei. I’m very proud of you.
: But no. I need to know how far you’re willing to go for not only my livelihood, but that of my friends as well.
: You’re not asking me to kill someone, are you?
scene nodokaoffice4
: No. But...if you’re offering, I think it’s safe to assume that you’re willing to go plenty far.
: I’m not.
: Are you sure?
: I am.
: Well, I suppose what I had in mind is easier anyway.
: What is it, then? And why should I have to go out on a limb for you despite you not really bringing anything other than high grades and perversion to the table?
scene nodokaoffice5
: Who says that is all I have to bring to the table?
: I come to you today with a proposition, Sensei.
: A chance to turn multiple lives around and improve the state of our class all through one menial task.
: How menial?
: Kidnapping.
: No.
scene nodokaoffice6
: No?
: Did you think I was just going to agree to kidnapping someone?
: I thought you’d at least think about it.
: What? No. How would kidnapping someone help improve the state of our class in the first place?
scene nodokaoffice7
: By turning it into something much more than just a class.
: By turning it into a paradise...
: Okay, listen. You haven’t transferred in yet, but I’ll let you know now that our class isn’t exactly a normal class.
: I’m aware. I heard all the details from Futaba.
: In fact, if it weren’t for the information I received from her, I never would have come up with this idea in the first place.
: You’re going to have to explain a little better than that.
scene nodokaoffice8
: No. I will not.
: Then I won’t do whatever it is-
: Because I will allow my beautiful assistant to do the explaining for me.
: ...What?
: Come! You may now enter!
: Nodoka, who is-
scene nodokaoffice9
The door opens and...in walks a peculiar combination of girls.
: What is going on right now?
: Dreams! Dreams are going on! Lots of them!
: Noriko, do you have any idea what Rin means by this?
: And wait, since when do you two even talk to each other?
: Since a few minutes ago.
: I’m not supposed to be here, but I came to see what you were doing and she was just...standing in the hall looking all determined and stuff.
: Determination! Dreams!
: Yes, Rin. I understand.
scene nodokaoffice10
: Noriko? This is the class you transferred into after Miss Watabe’s?
: I was certain they were just kicking you out of[school].
: Nope! Just putting me back where I belong!
: Have you already been notified of what’s going on right now?
: More or less. I know Otoha is involved and that’s enough to count me in.
: Otoha? The musician girl?
Well that certainly explains why Rin looks like...that.
scene nodokaoffice11
: Precisely.
: I want you to kidnap Otoha Okakura, ensure that she winds up in your class, and convert the[school] into the ultimate yuritopia.
: Yuritopia!
: I get why Rin would want that, but why would you make something like this a condition?
: Aren’t you going to ask me how I know Otoha?
: I just assumed it was through your sister.
scene nodokaoffice12
: Nope! We used to be in a band together.
: Cool, right?
: Yuritopia!
: To get back on track, the reason that I’m making this a “condition” is that I’ve been quite worried about Otoha’s well-being lately.
: She doesn’t fare well being cooped up in her house with overbearing parents all day so, as her friend, rescuing her is currently my top priority.
scene nodokaoffice13
: Yeah. Yuri stuff aside, Otoha’s seemed really drained lately.
: And I’ve already been talking to her about transferring over for a while...but she’s still on the fence for some reason.
: I figure that if we could make sure she winds up in our class, though, she’ll definitely do it.
: And since her and Nodoka are friends already, the two of them could room together.
: The groundwork has already been laid, Sensei. It now falls on you to ensure the rest of the building is built.
: Why me?
: What can I do that you guys can’t?
: I’ve barely even talked to Otoha.
scene nodokaoffice14
: Absolutely nothing!
: Why do you look so proud in saying that?
scene nodokaoffice15
: Because the solution is quite simple.
: I believe the main reason that Otoha is afraid of transferring[school]s is because she can’t guarantee her grades will remain high enough to spend her free time as she pleases.
: The transition to homeschooling has already negatively impacted her GPA, and she is now on the cusp of having to retire as a musician until she is out of [high_school].
: As a fellow prodigy and the ultimate friend, I refuse to let talent like hers go to waste.
: So where you come in is ensuring her that her grades will remain safe and secure in this new environment.
: Also, I need reference material for something I’m writing and want to closely study any potential relationship (Or lack thereof) including her and my new assistant here.
: This isn’t exactly “kidnapping,” Nodoka.
: If she vehemently refuses to comply, I am not against binding her and tossing her into the back of your car.
: I don’t have a car.
: Well then we should hope Plan A succeeds so you don’t need to obtain one.
: And I take it that you two are in complete agreement with all aspects of this plan?
scene nodokaoffice16
: I like Plan B more. But yeah, it would be cool to have Otoha around again. She’s super chill.
: I like both plans, but I’m pretty sure you already know that by now.
: Yeah, I don’t know why I included you at all.
: Is it settled, then? You’ll accompany us on an excursion to steal her?
: Wait, I actually have to go somewhere?
: Futaba informed me that your affinity for cute girls is the only reason you travel in the first place, so I figured it would be fine.
: It is. I’m just obligated to complain about things that require me exerting any amount of effort.
: Want me to just go tie her up and bring her here in your place?
: I can probably borrow one of the 567 cars.
: I don’t know how to drive yet, but I’m sure I’m smart enough to figure it out.
: When is this trip exactly?
: Does tomorrow work for you? Otoha has free time after her lessons on Wednesday that she usually spends in a park near our old[school].
: Nodoka and I already planned on going to see her, but if you came too I’m sure we could get her to agree to at least try it out.
: Again, the trick is to really just hammer in that her grades won’t be an issue.
: I feel like you three are really taking advantage of how horrible of a teacher I am right now.
scene nodokaoffice17
: Hey, don’t call yourself horrible. You’re just going through some stuff right now.
: You’ve helped me a lot, remember?
: You’ve helped me a lot too, but like...I don’t know if I’d really call you a “good” teacher or whatever.
: I honestly don’t care. I only come here out of obligation. I’ve already been pre-accepted to the college of my choice.
Have fun getting there, though.
: Sure, I’ll come with you tomorrow.
: There are no hidden caveats to any of this, though, right?
: I don’t want to agree to taking in Otoha as well only to find that I’m going to need to like, pay for her phone bill or something.
: My plan maxes out at five lines and I’m already there.
scene nodokaoffice18
: Why are you paying for five phone lines?
: Did you figure out a way to clone Ami?
: Don’t worry about it.
: Me or Rin? Because we had two very different questions and I would like my own Ami clone if that's okay with you.
: Both of you...
: There are no hidden caveats, but I do urge you to consider just how happy it would make all three of us if you were to agree.
: Also, you will be cordially invited to our first joint slumber party as a reward for your cooperation.
: Say no more. I’m in.
scene nodokaoffice19
: YURITOPIA!
: The promised land awaits, dear assistant.
: Hell yeah! Cute girls making out!
: Tentatively!
: I’ll probably find a way to ruin it!
: You know, I’ve seen some strange things in here, but this is probably among the strangest.
: Shhhhh...read the room. We’re having a moment right now.
: But it’s...my room.
: Shut up, Sensei! You know you like it!
scene black
The three of them proceed to celebrate without my inclusion for the next five minutes or so before Nodoka calls on the group to disperse.
Noriko has work today and Rin has plans with Futaba, so the two of them wind up leaving as soon as the call is made.
Nodoka, on the other hand, feels the need to stay behind for some reason...
scene nodokaoffice20
: You did a good thing today, Sensei.
: There’s more to you than just rants about manipulation and impure thoughts, isn’t there?
: Not much else, but yeah. I can do something nice every once in a while, I guess.
: Well it earned you a handful of Nodoka points. Good job.
: Nodoka points?
: The Nodoka currency. You can use them to redeem Nodoka rewards.
: How many do I have?
: Five. But I won't be stingy in handing them out, so I'm sure you'll be rolling in them before you know it.
: Is there any reward I can buy with five points?
: Are you sure you don’t want to save them up for something better?
: I don’t even know what the rewards are yet.
: Perhaps it’s better that you don’t.
: ...What?
scene nodokaoffice21
: See you tomorrow, Sensei~
scene black
Nodoka leaves the room and I am suddenly alone with nothing but my Nodoka points.
I didn’t think I’d be earning any imaginary currency during today’s visit, but I also didn’t plan on agreeing to “kidnap” the girl Rin has a crush on either...
So I guess today was all sorts of weird.
But that’s just how things are now, I guess.
And with the class on the brink of being entirely full-
I’m sure things will only get weirder...
